{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./application.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   mppwidth=1 (total ranks) -> -n 1
#   walltime=00:03:00        -> -t 3m
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 3m -o output=APPLICATION.log --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -N APPLICATION not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: PBS -l mppdepth=1 and mppnppn=1 do not have direct portable Flux equivalents.
  # Performance implication: placement topology may differ, potentially affecting performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -j oe not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  # NOTE: PBS -o APPLICATION.log translated to flux batch output option (output=APPLICATION.log).

  # NOTE: Commented PBS -q gpu_nodes not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources.

  # No application command was provided in the original PBS script.
  # Add your executable below.
  flux run -n 1 ./APPLICATION
fi
"
}
